welcome.title: Let's see what they know about you
welcome.subtitle: Google and Meta store more than you imagine: where you've been, what you searched, what you watched. This app shows you and helps you delete it. Everything happens on your computer: nothing is uploaded to the internet.

googleGuide.title: First: download your data from Google
googleGuide.intro: Google calls this "Takeout": a .zip file with your activity. We'll guide you step by step.
steps: Open takeout.google.com in your browser and sign in with your Google account.
In the product list, keep at least: My Activity, Location History and YouTube and YouTube Music. (You can keep everything selected.)
For "File type" choose .zip. For "Maximum size" choose the largest available.
Google will email you when it's ready. It can take hours or even days: that's normal.
When the email arrives, download ALL the .zip files (there may be several: takeout-001.zip, takeout-002.zip…) and keep them together in one folder.
googleGuide.patience: The export can take hours or days. You can close this app: we'll be here.

import.title: Import your export
import.select: Choose my .zip files or their folder
import.hint: You can pick several .zip files at once, or the folder containing them. No need to unzip.
import.processing: Reading your files on this computer…
import.processingNote: Nothing leaves your device. Large files may take a few minutes.

notTakeout.title: This doesn't look like a Google Takeout
help: Pick the .zip files you downloaded from takeout.google.com (don't unzip them).
If you picked a folder, check that the .zip files are inside it.
If the problem persists, go back to takeout.google.com and create a new export in .zip format.
